$comment: Ground truth for real photographs of a Microlife BP B1 Classic.
Add a photo to this folder, add an entry here, and `npm run ocr:real` will grade it.
sys/dia/pul  the values a human reads off the display
accept       false when the recogniser must refuse the photo entirely
date         { month, day } if the header shows a date, else omit
average      true when the 'A' stored-average marker is lit
note         why this photo is here

photos.note: Stored average. Bright reflection over the top-left, no date in the header.
Straight-on measurement, unlit segments faintly ghosting.
Low contrast, a hard shadow edge cutting diagonally across the panel.
Power-on self test: every segment lit. Reading it as 888/888 would be nonsense, so it must be refused.
